note: Resort and marina on Table Rock Lake at Kimberling City, where a hotel and cabins stand beside a campground in three areas: The Bluff, Middle Park and East Park. The full-hookup sites are in Middle Park; East Park's electric/water sites and The Bluff's electric and tent sites look over the lake across a road or a wooded bluff edge. Pool, hot tub, playground, sports courts and a dog park, plus boat slips at the marina. Weekly, monthly and year-round stays are also sold. --Claude
